Ok interesting, so this is a legit use case, which client have you used to get the response ? I recommend to not use jq as it can affect your testing environment. It gets OOM killed even with smaller json outputs. ``` [214768.325661] Out of memory: Killed process 28957 (jq) total-vm:20703436kB, anon-rss:20430816kB, file-rss:1768kB, shmem-rss:0kB, UID:0 pgtables:40560kB ``` With this block, even with an excellent network throughput, 80 Gbps to simplify (i.e 10 GiB/s), it will take more than 60 seconds to stream the response. This changes the way we design timeouts on RPC load. We had to create a specific timeout for this case (debugTraceBlock) there is no client..., I generated that with the execution engine I've been working on https://github.com/racytech/artex... testing it as much as I can... traces on such a big output would help a lot those are samples for lines 1317726, 2635452 3953178 and the last line with the state root if it's okay would you verify against besu's whenever possible? very interesting, a lot of padded zeros oh shoot those are 32byte memory items, shouldn't be they stay as is? or zeros stripped? can you share besu's output for the same 3 lines please? excerpts.author: ahamlat
excerpts.content:
I recommend to not use jq as it can affect your testing environment. It gets OOM killed even with smaller json outputs.
```
[214768.325661] Out of memory: Killed process 28957 (jq) total-vm:20703436kB, anon-rss:20430816kB, file-rss:1768kB, shmem-rss:0kB, UID:0 pgtables:40560kB
```

excerpts.author: ahamlat
excerpts.content: With this block, even with an excellent network throughput, 80 Gbps to simplify (i.e 10 GiB/s), it will take more than 60 seconds to stream the response. This changes the way we design timeouts on RPC load. We had to create a specific timeout for this case (debugTraceBlock)
